metas.name: Area around Santiago - semi-arid climate
metas.note: The region around Santiago can be recognized by its semi-arid climate, having dry hills and scattered vegetation.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Arica y Parinacota  - mountains
metas.note: The province of Arica y Parinacota can be recognized by the smooth, sandy mountains that may look slightly eroded, or have bulbous formations. Valleys are also common, which are rarely seen in other parts of Chile.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Atacama and Northern Coquimbo - rocky mountains
metas.note: These rocky, uneven mountains are most commonly seen in Atacama and northern Coquimbo.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Bio Bio - Conception Pines
metas.note: Concepcion pines, scientifically named Pinus radiata, can be recognized by their puffy needles. They are most commonly found in Bio Bio, where the city of Concepcion is located, and less commonly in Ñuble and Araucania.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Chile Highway 9 - Concrete Road with all yellow lines
metas.note: All yellow lines on a concrete road are a good indicator that you are on the paved section of Ruta 9, in the very south of Chile. The landscape tends to be barren, grassy, and treeless.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Chiloe - landscape
metas.note:
A rolling, agricultural landscape, comparable to New Zealand, can be seen on Isla Grande de Chiloé.

NOTE: Similar looking landscapes exist in some other parts of the country, but usually more level.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Chiloe and mainland east of it - Chilean Rhubarb
metas.note: Chilean rhubarb can commonly be found on Isla Grande, and on the mainland east of it. Chilean rhubarb can be recognized by its large, cabbage-like appearance.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Far east Araucania - Monkey Puzzles
metas.note:
Monkey puzzles, scientifically named Araucaria araucana, are found in far eastern Araucania.

NOTE: Monkey puzzles can also be found on the other side of the Argentinian border.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Maule Province - Mediterranean climate
metas.note: Compared to the area around Santiago, the Maule province has a similar look. However, it has a Mediterranean climate, and is generally greener. Vineyards are also commonly seen in this region.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Southern Aysen - autumn coverage
metas.note: Southern Aysén can be recognised by autumn coverage, having orange and red coloured vegetation. Keep in mind that not all coverage in this region will have fall colours.
metas.footer:

metas.name: Southern Los Lagos and northern Aysén. - Lush green valleys
metas.note: Lush green valleys, with rocky mountains and often overcast coverage, can be seen in southern Los Lagos and northern Aysén.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Southern Valparaiso - Eucalyptus plantations
metas.note: Eucalyptus plantations combined with a somewhat dry climate are a good indicator that you are in southwestern Valparaíso.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.
